scope: bounded functional S1/S2/S4 GPU comparison; not a powered superiority study
source_design: two balanced probe blocks plus three independent confirmation Jobs per configuration, per source
oracle: target grid_characterization after all tuning studies; results unavailable to tuners
independent_unit: study for method comparison; Job for within-configuration repeats; forward blocks are subsamples
failure_policy: preserve failed attempts; stop on unqualified context, pressure or ineligible thermal trace; no budget or policy relaxation
source_cost_policy: report full source characterization, selected source profile cost, and F0 separately; never recharge prior source time as target work
limits: two study blocks do not establish statistically powered superiority
generated fixed-weight CNN is a numerical fixture, not task accuracy
three configurations may favor exhaustive measurement; report null improvement without enlarging space
only CPU request/thread count varies; GPU count and runtime remain fixed
cpu_thread_mapping: max(1, int(requested_cpu)); fractional CPU is enforced by cgroup quota
